user: Documented why the conquest cast button vanished on fresh games — a one-word Svelte 5 fix
what: New learning page: plain `let` assigned in async onMount never re-renders; declare `$state`

summary: Recorded the Svelte 5 reactivity gotcha behind PR #11 (conquest cast button): plain `let` assigned only inside async onMount callbacks never triggers a re-render, so `{#if gameId}` stayed false on fresh games — must be `$state`. Includes the symptom shape and links to the TV cast views + sessionStorage stopgap decision (why /match/risk has no cast button until M3).
